name: fight15-s02
title: Joiner Ready and host immediate-start eligibility

scripts.host.menu:
wait_ms 1800
activate ButtonMainToMultiplayer
wait_ms 600
assert_substate Landing
settext TextMultiplayerName Captain
activate ButtonMultiplayerHostGame
wait_ms 500
assert_substate HostSetup
combo_select ComboHostActivity Skirmish Defense
combo_select ComboHostScene Grasslands
setup_host_port {PORT}
combo_select ComboHostPlayers 2
activate ButtonHostOptions
wait_ms 500
assert_substate HostOptions
activate TabHostPageConnection
combo_select ComboHostNetVisibility Public (default)
combo_select ComboHostNetRelay Game service (default)
assert_label ComboHostNetVisibility Public (default)
assert_label ComboHostNetRelay Game service (default)
activate ButtonHostOptBack
wait_ms 500
activate ButtonMultiplayerCreate
wait_substate Lobby 90
video_mark fight15-host-listening
wait_connected 2 90
wait_ms 1200
assert_label LabelMultiplayerStatus Waiting for Joiner to press Ready
video_mark ready-before-host
wait_remote_ready 90
wait_ms 1200
text_watch start ready-host-state equals substate:Lobby LabelMultiplayerStatus Everyone is ready - press Start Match
text_watch start ready-host-layout layout substate:Lobby
text_watch start ready-host-duplicates duplicates substate:Lobby
text_watch start ready-host-persistent shown substate:Lobby LabelMultiplayerStatus
video_mark ready-after-host
wait_ms 1600
text_watch assert ready-host-state
text_watch assert ready-host-layout
text_watch assert ready-host-duplicates
text_watch assert ready-host-persistent
assert_enabled ButtonMultiplayerStart 1
wait_file {PROBE_DIR}/done.json 120
wait_ms 1400
exit
scripts.joiner.menu:
wait_ms 1800
activate ButtonMainToMultiplayer
wait_ms 600
assert_substate Landing
settext TextMultiplayerName Joiner
activate ButtonMultiplayerJoinGame
wait_ms 600
assert_substate JoinSetup
wait_row PublicGameRowPort{PORT} 90
click_row PublicGameRowPort{PORT}
assert_label LabelJoinSelected internet
assert_enabled ButtonMultiplayerConnect 1
activate ButtonMultiplayerConnect
wait_connected 2 90
wait_substate Lobby 90
wait_ms 1200
video_mark ready-before-joiner
assert_label ButtonMultiplayerReady Ready
wait_ms 2500
activate ButtonMultiplayerReady
wait_ms 1200
text_watch start ready-joiner-state equals substate:Lobby LabelMultiplayerStatus You're ready - waiting for the host to start the match
text_watch start ready-joiner-layout layout substate:Lobby
text_watch start ready-joiner-duplicates duplicates substate:Lobby
text_watch start ready-joiner-persistent shown substate:Lobby LabelMultiplayerStatus
video_mark ready-after-joiner
wait_ms 1600
text_watch assert ready-joiner-state
text_watch assert ready-joiner-layout
text_watch assert ready-joiner-duplicates
text_watch assert ready-joiner-persistent
wait_file {PROBE_DIR}/done.json 120
wait_ms 1400
exit

checklist.what: A held Ready click changes the exact state and it stays drawn inside the lobby.
A held Ready click changes the exact state and it stays drawn inside the lobby.
